```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r notes-front, results='asis'}
nt <- params$notes
.has <- function(k) is.list(nt) && !is.null(nt[[k]]) && nzchar(nt[[k]])
.p <- function(x) paste0("<p>", gsub("\n+", "</p><p>", htmltools::htmlEscape(trimws(x))), "</p>")
if (.has("title") || .has("authors")) {
  cat("<div class='report-cover'>")
  if (.has("title")) cat("<h1 class='report-title'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(nt$title), "</h1>", sep = "")
  if (.has("authors")) cat("<p class='report-authors'>", htmltools::htmlEscape(nt$authors), "</p>", sep = "")
  cat("</div>\n\n")
}
for (sec in list(c("background", "Background"), c("objectives", "Objectives"), c("method", "Method"))) {
  if (.has(sec[1])) cat("## ", sec[2], "\n\n", .p(nt[[sec[1]]]), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Analysis Overview

```{r overview, results='asis'}
vars <- params$selected_vars
if (!is.null(vars) && length(vars) > 0) {
  cat("**Indicators used:** ", paste(vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (!is.null(params$best_k) && !is.na(params$best_k)) {
  cat("**Selected solution:** ", params$best_k, " profiles\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Model Fit Comparison

Model selection should be based on a combination of information criteria (lower
AIC/BIC is better), entropy (values of .80 or above indicate clear separation),
the smallest class proportion, and the BLRT, alongside the theoretical
interpretability of the profiles (Nylund et al., 2007; Masyn, 2013).

```{r fit-compare}
fc <- params$fit_compare
if (!is.null(fc) && nrow(fc) > 0) {
  fc_disp <- fc
  num_cols <- vapply(fc_disp, is.numeric, logical(1))
  fc_disp[num_cols] <- lapply(fc_disp[num_cols], function(x) round(x, 3))
  kable(fc_disp, format = "html", row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No model comparison results available.")
}
```

```{r summary-table}

if (!is.null(st) && nrow(st) > 0) {
  kable(st, format = "html", row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {

}
```

}
